description: Fetch full detail for a specific state bill. Accepts either the three-part path (jurisdiction + session + bill_id) or a direct OCD bill ID (openstates_id from search results). Use include to request votes, actions, sponsorships, documents, and versions in one call rather than searching again. include=votes returns the full vote tally and per-legislator positions. include=actions returns the complete action history. Prefer openstates_id when available to avoid session identifier lookup.

bill_id.description: Bill identifier as used by the legislature (e.g., "HB 1000", "SB 42"). Required with jurisdiction + session.

include.description: Related data to inline. "sponsorships", "actions", "votes" are most commonly needed. "versions" and "documents" provide links to bill text and fiscal notes.

jurisdiction.description: State name, abbreviation, or OCD-ID. Required when using path-based lookup with session + bill_id.

openstates_id.description: OCD bill ID from openstates_search_bills results (e.g., "ocd-bill/..."). Preferred over the three-part path when available.

session.description: Session identifier. Required with jurisdiction + bill_id.

name: openstates_get_bill

abstracts.description: Bill abstracts when include=abstracts is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

actions.description: Full action history when include=actions is requested.

date.description: Action date. Empty string when Open States recorded no date.

documents.description: Bill documents (fiscal notes, etc.) when include=documents is requested.

date.description: Document date. Empty string when Open States recorded no date, which is the usual case for bill documents.

note.description: Document note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_lookup_params`: Neither openstates_id nor the complete jurisdiction+session+bill_id triple was provided. `not_found`: Bill does not exist at the given path or OCD ID. `upstream_timeout`: Open States did not answer within the per-request timeout. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

identifier.description: Bill identifier as used by the legislature.

openstates_url.description: Open States URL for this bill.

other_identifiers.description: Alternate identifiers when include=other_identifiers is requested.

scheme.description: Identifier scheme (the issuing system). Absent for bills — Open States omits it on every bill record observed.

other_titles.description: Alternate titles when include=other_titles is requested.

note.description: Note describing the alternate title. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

related_bills.description: Related bills when include=related_bills is requested.

sources.description: Source documents when include=sources is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

id.description: OCD person ID. Pass it to openstates_search_people as id for the full legislator record, or back to openstates_search_bills as the sponsor filter for their other bills.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary sponsor.

updated_at.description: Timestamp Open States last updated this record — the field openstates_search_bills sorts by under the default sort=updated_desc.

versions.description: Bill text versions when include=versions is requested.

date.description: Version date. Empty string when Open States recorded no date, which is the usual case for bill versions.

note.description: Version note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

votes.description: Vote events when include=votes is requested.

value.description: Count of votes for this option.

start_date.description: Vote date. Empty string when Open States recorded no date.

title: Get Bill
